properties.description: Eight real-binary tests with an isolated HOME (see art:test-every-client-mode-honours-read-only), plus read_only_client's unit tests (a write refused without asking the server; a read both sides agree on forwarded and the list read once; an unconfirmable read refused; the file rule; the server's own list replies learned; every file writer served and taking its file as `path`; this build's half is the whole served surface) and tools::tests::every_guarded_file_writer_is_on_the_list_a_read_only_client_reads.
properties.findings: OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on main c4e1cbd: all 8 failed — the write landed through --remote, --shared and a pointer-attached client; the stand-in received add_requirement; the latent surface started a design; --shared --read-only created a store; the "initialize" call got no reply; a plain --remote client lost its session. On the branch: 8/8 pass, and the finding's own measurement script re-run on the branch binary shows every client refusing with the store unchanged (measure-fix.log).
properties.name: Every client mode honours --read-only: a write is refused before it is sent, a read passes, the store is unchanged
